intro.en: In this lesson we read about the Quran as the lasting miracle of the Messenger ﷺ: how it was revealed in parts, its inimitability, Makki and Madani surahs, and how it was collected. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum Quran ke baare mein parhenge ke woh Rasool ﷺ ka hamesha rehne wala mojiza hai: yeh thoda thoda kaise nazil hua, iska mojiza hona, Makki aur Madani suratein, aur Quran kaise jama kiya gaya. Aahista aahista jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ في هَذَا الدَّرْسِ عَنِ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ، المُعْجِزَةِ الخالِدَةِ لِلرَّسولِ ﷺ: نُزولِهِ مُنَجَّماً، وَإِعْجازِهِ، وَالسُّوَرِ المَكِّيَّةِ وَالمَدَنِيَّة، وَجَمْعِهِ. اقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَة.

dialogue.ar: لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ مُعْجِزَةٌ تَشْهَدُ بِصِدْقِهِ، وَقَدْ أَيَّدَ اللهُ كُلَّ رَسولٍ بِما يُناسِبُ زَمانَهُ.
dialogue.tr: likulli nabiyyin muʿjizatun tashhadu biṣidqih wa-qad ayyada llāhu kulla rasūlin bimā yunāsibu zamānah
dialogue.en: Every prophet had a miracle that bears witness to his truthfulness, and Allah supported each messenger with what suited his time.
dialogue.ur: Har nabi ka ek mojiza tha jo uski sachai ki gawahi deta tha, aur Allah ne har rasool ki madad us cheez se ki jo uske zamane ke mutabiq thi.

dialogue.ar: فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ عَصا مُوسى عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ، وَناقَةُ صالِحٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-min dhālika ʿaṣā mūsā ʿalayhi s-salām wa-nāqatu ṣāliḥin ʿalayhi s-salām
dialogue.en: Among them were the staff of Musa and the she-camel of Salih, peace be upon them both.
dialogue.ur: Unmein Musa عليه السلام ka asa aur Salih عليه السلام ki untni hain.

dialogue.ar: وَرَأى الصَّحابَةُ في زَمَنِ نَبِيِّنا ﷺ انْشِقاقَ القَمَرِ، وَشَهِدوا مُعْجِزاتٍ أُخْرى.
dialogue.tr: wa-raʾā ṣ-ṣaḥābatu fī zamani nabiyyinā nshiqāqa l-qamar wa-shahidwā muʿjizātin ukhrā
dialogue.en: In the time of our Prophet ﷺ the Companions saw the splitting of the moon and witnessed other miracles.
dialogue.ur: Hamare Nabi ﷺ ke zamane mein sahaba ne chand ka phatna dekha aur doosre mojizaat bhi dekhe.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّ تِلْكَ المُعْجِزاتِ الحِسِّيَّةَ انْتَهَتْ بِانْتِهاءِ وَقْتِها، وَالَّتي لا تَزولُ هِيَ القُرْآنُ الكَريمُ، فَهُوَ خالِدٌ إِلى يَوْمِ القِيامَةِ.
dialogue.tr: lakinna tilka l-muʿjizāti l-ḥissiyyata ntahat bintihāʾi wa-qtihā wa-llatī lā tazūlu hiya l-qurʾānu l-karīm fa-huwa khālidun ilā yawmi l-qiyāma
dialogue.en: But those sensory miracles ended when their time ended, whereas the one that does not vanish is the Noble Quran, which is eternal until the Day of Resurrection.
dialogue.ur: Lekin woh mahsoos mojizaat apne waqt ke saath khatam ho gaye, aur jo kabhi khatam nahi hota woh Quran-e-Kareem hai, jo qiyamat tak hamesha rahega.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالى: ﴿إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: innā naḥnu nazzalnā dh-dhikra wa innā lahu laḥāfiẓūn
dialogue.en: Allah the Exalted said: Indeed, We sent down the Reminder, and indeed We will guard it. [Al-Hijr 9]
dialogue.ur: Allah ne farmaya: Beshak hum ne yeh Zikr nazil kiya aur beshak hum hi uski hifazat karne wale hain. [Al-Hijr 9]

dialogue.ar: وَلَمْ يَنْزِلِ القُرْآنُ دُفْعَةً واحِدَةً، بَلْ أَنْزَلَهُ اللهُ مُنَجَّماً بِحَسَبِ الحَوادِثِ وَحاجَةِ النّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-lam yanzili l-qurʾānu dufʿatan wāḥida bal anzalahu llāhu munajjaman biḥasabi l-ḥawādithi wa-ḥājati n-nās
dialogue.en: The Quran was not revealed all at once; Allah revealed it in parts, according to events and people's needs.
dialogue.ur: Quran ek hi baar nazil nahi hua, balkeh Allah ne use waqiaat aur logon ki zaroorat ke mutabiq thoda thoda nazil kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَفي ذَلِكَ حِكْمَةٌ بالِغَةٌ، فَهُوَ تَثْبيتٌ لِقُلوبِ المُؤْمِنينَ وَتَيْسيرٌ عَلَيْهِمْ في الحِفْظِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-fī dhālika ḥikmatun bāligha fa-huwa tathbītun liqulūbi l-muʾminīna wa-taysīrun ʿalayhim fī l-ḥifẓ
dialogue.en: There is deep wisdom in this: it strengthens the hearts of the believers and makes memorising easier for them.
dialogue.ur: Is mein gehri hikmat hai: isse momino ke dil mazboot hote hain aur unke liye hifz aasaan hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَحَدّى اللهُ بِالقُرْآنِ الإِنْسَ وَالجِنَّ جَميعاً، فَعَجَزوا عَنْ أَنْ يَأْتوا بِسُورَةٍ مِثْلِ سُوَرِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-taḥaddā llāhu bil-qurʾāni l-ʾinsa wal-jinna jamīʿā fa-ʿajazwā ʿan an yaʾtwā bisūratin mithli suwarih
dialogue.en: Allah challenged mankind and the jinn together with the Quran, and they were unable to bring a surah like its surahs.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne Quran ke zariye insanon aur jinnon sab ko challenge kiya, aur woh iski suraton jaisi koi surat na la sake.

dialogue.ar: وَيَظْهَرُ إِعْجازُهُ في أُسْلوبِهِ الفَريدِ، وَحُسْنِ كَلِماتِهِ، وَعُمْقِ مَعانيهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yaẓharu iʿjāzuhu fī uslūbihi l-farīd wa-ḥusni kalimātih wa-ʿumqi maʿānīh
dialogue.en: Its inimitability shows in its unique style, the beauty of its words and the depth of its meanings.
dialogue.ur: Iska mojiza hona iske anokhe andaz, alfaaz ki khoobsurti aur maani ki gehrai mein nazar aata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَنْقَسِمُ القُرْآنُ مِنْ حَيْثُ مَكانُ النُّزولِ إِلى مَكِّيٍّ نَزَلَ قَبْلَ الهِجْرَةِ، وَمَدَنِيٍّ نَزَلَ بَعْدَها.
dialogue.tr: wa-yanqasimu l-qurʾānu min ḥaythu makānu n-nuzūli ilā makkiyyin nazala qabla l-hijra wa-madaniyyin nazala baʿdahā
dialogue.en: According to the place of revelation, the Quran is divided into Makki, revealed before the Hijra, and Madani, revealed after it.
dialogue.ur: Nuzool ki jagah ke lihaz se Quran Makki (hijrat se pehle utra) aur Madani (hijrat ke baad utra) mein taqseem hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَاسْتَمَرَّ نُزولُهُ ثَلاثاً وَعِشْرينَ سَنَةً بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالمَدينَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wastamarra nuzūluhu thalāthan wa-ʿishrīna sanatan bayna makkata wal-madīna
dialogue.en: Its revelation continued for twenty-three years between Makkah and Madinah.
dialogue.ur: Iska nuzool teis (23) saal tak Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan jari raha.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ وَفاةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ خافَ الصَّحابَةُ ضَياعَ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ، فَجُمِعَ لِأَوَّلِ مَرَّةٍ في عَهْدِ الخَليفَةِ أَبي بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-baʿda wa-fāti n-nabiyyi khāfa ṣ-ṣaḥābatu ḍayāʿa shayʾin minh fa-jumiʿa liʾawwali marratin fī ʿahdi l-khalīfati abī bakrin raḍiya llāhu ʿanh
dialogue.en: After the death of the Prophet ﷺ the Companions feared that some of it might be lost, so it was collected for the first time in the era of the caliph Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him.
dialogue.ur: Nabi ﷺ ki wafat ke baad sahaba ko dar tha ke kuch hissa zaya na ho jaye, isliye pehli baar Khalifa Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه ke daur mein jama kiya gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَفي عَهْدِ عُثْمانَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ دُوِّنَ في مُصْحَفٍ واحِدٍ، وَأُرْسِلَتْ نُسَخٌ مِنْهُ إِلى البُلْدانِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-fī ʿahdi ʿuthmāna raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu duwwina fī muṣḥafin wāḥid wa-ʾursilat nusakhun minhu ilā l-buldān
dialogue.en: In the era of Uthman, may Allah be pleased with him, it was compiled in one muṣḥaf, and copies of it were sent to the lands.
dialogue.ur: Hazrat Usman رضي الله عنه ke daur mein ise ek mushaf mein likha gaya aur uski nuskhe mulkon ki taraf bheji gayin.

vocab.en: a bound copy of the Quran

q.en: According to the text, what is the eternal miracle of the Messenger ﷺ?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq Rasool ﷺ ka hamesha rehne wala mojiza kya hai?
q.ar: حَسَبَ النَّصِّ، ما المُعْجِزَةُ الخالِدَةُ لِلرَّسولِ ﷺ؟

q.en: Why was the Quran revealed in parts?
q.ur: Quran thoda thoda kyun nazil hua?

options: To strengthen hearts and make memorising easy
To make it harder to learn
Because people asked for the Torah
It was not revealed in parts

q.en: How long did the revelation of the Quran take?
q.ur: Quran ke nuzool mein kitna waqt laga?

q.en: Who first collected the Quran into one muṣḥaf?
q.ur: Quran ko pehli baar ek mushaf mein kisne jama kiya?
q.ar: مَنْ جَمَعَ القُرْآنَ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ في مُصْحَفٍ واحِد؟

intro.en: Here we practise the new words of the text: finding synonyms, matching verbs with their prepositions, and using words like مُعْجِزَة and هِجْرَة in sentences.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum text ke naye alfaaz ki mashq karte hain: hum-maani alfaaz dhoondhna, fel ko uske harf-e-jar se milana, aur mojiza, hijrat jaise alfaaz jumlon mein istemal karna.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى كَلِماتِ النَّصِّ الجَديدَة: إِيجادِ المُرادِفات، وَرَبْطِ الأَفْعالِ بِحُروفِ الجَرِّ الَّتي تُناسِبُها، وَاسْتِعْمالِ كَلِماتٍ مِثْلِ مُعْجِزَة وَهِجْرَة في جُمَل.

q.ur: "Nabi (bohat se)" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?

intro.en: A simple sentence has a subject and a predicate: الرَّجُلُ نائِمٌ. When we put كانَ or one of its sisters before it, the subject stays raised (marfūʿ) and the predicate becomes accusative (manṣūb): كانَ الرَّجُلُ نائِماً – The man was asleep. The sisters include صارَ، أَصْبَحَ، أَضْحى، أَمْسى، ظَلَّ، لَيْسَ، ما دامَ، ما زالَ and ما بَرِحَ.
intro.ur: Aam jumla mubtada aur khabar se banta hai: الرَّجُلُ نائِمٌ. Jab hum us se pehle كانَ ya uski behnein lagate hain to mubtada marfoo rehta hai aur khabar mansoob ho jati hai: كانَ الرَّجُلُ نائِماً – Aadmi soya hua tha. Behnein: صارَ، أَصْبَحَ، أَضْحى، أَمْسى، ظَلَّ، لَيْسَ، ما دامَ، ما زالَ, ما بَرِحَ.
intro.ar: الجُمْلَةُ الاسْمِيَّةُ لَها مُبْتَدَأٌ وَخَبَر: الرَّجُلُ نائِمٌ. وَإِذا دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْها «كانَ» أَوْ إِحْدى أَخَواتِها بَقِيَ المُبْتَدَأُ مَرْفوعاً وَصارَ الخَبَرُ مَنْصوباً: كانَ الرَّجُلُ نائِماً. وَمِنْ أَخَواتِها: صارَ، أَصْبَحَ، أَضْحى، أَمْسى، ظَلَّ، لَيْسَ، ما دامَ، ما زالَ، ما بَرِحَ.

q.en: What case does the predicate take after كانَ?
q.ur: Kana ke baad khabar kis haalat mein aati hai?

q.en: Which word is a sister of كانَ?
q.ur: Kana ki behen kaun sa lafz hai?

q.ar: ما مَعْنى «لَيْسَ» في نَحْوِ «لَيْسَ الطّالِبُ غائِباً»؟

intro.en: Listen to the audio about the Quran, then answer true or false. Useful facts: the Quran came down in parts, it is also called al-Kitāb, al-Dhikr and al-Furqān, and it was collected to protect it from being lost.
intro.ur: Quran ke baare mein audio sunein, phir sahi ya ghalat ka jawab dein. Aham baatein: Quran thoda thoda nazil hua, isse al-Kitab, az-Zikr aur al-Furqan bhi kehte hain, aur isse zaaya hone se bachane ke liye jama kiya gaya.
intro.ar: اسْتَمِعْ إِلى التَّسْجيلِ عَنِ القُرْآنِ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأ. مِنَ الحَقائِق: نَزَلَ القُرْآنُ مُنَجَّماً، وَمِنْ أَسْمائِهِ الكِتابُ وَالذِّكْرُ وَالفُرْقان، وَجُمِعَ لِحِفْظِهِ مِنَ الضَّياع.

vocab.ur: furqan, haq-batil mein farq karne wala

q.en: Was the Quran revealed all at once?
q.ur: Kya Quran ek hi baar mein nazil hua?

q.en: Which is a name of the Quran?
q.ur: Quran ka naam kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ هَذِهِ الكَلِماتِ مِنْ أَسْماءِ القُرْآن؟

options_ar: الطَّريقُ الواضِحُ الَّذي لا اعْوِجاجَ فيه

intro.en: Practise asking and answering questions about the Quran with a partner, then write a short essay of at least 150 words titled «القُرْآنُ الكَريم» using the guiding questions.
intro.ur: Apne saathi ke saath Quran ke baare mein sawal jawab ki mashq karein, phir «القُرْآنُ الكَريم» ke unwan par kam az kam 150 alfaaz ka mazmoon rehnumai ke sawalon ki madad se likhein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى طَرْحِ الأَسْئِلَةِ وَالإِجابَةِ عَنْها حَوْلَ القُرْآنِ الكَريم. ثُمَّ اكْتُبْ مَوْضوعاً لا يَقِلُّ عَنْ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسينَ كَلِمَةً بِعُنْوانِ «القُرْآنُ الكَريم» مُسْتَعيناً بِالأَسْئِلَةِ المُوَجِّهَة.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ سُورَةً تَحْفَظُ مِنَ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ؟
dialogue.tr: kam sūratan taḥfaẓu mina l-qurʾāni l-karīm
dialogue.en: How many surahs do you memorise from the Noble Quran?
dialogue.ur: Aap Quran-e-Kareem ki kitni suratein yaad rakhte hain?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ هُناكَ سِنٌّ مُناسِبَةٌ لِلْبَدْءِ بِحِفْظِ القُرْآنِ؟ وَما هِيَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal hunāka sinnun munāsibatun lil-badʾi biḥifẓi l-qurʾān wa-mā hiy
dialogue.en: Is there a suitable age to begin memorising the Quran? What is it?
dialogue.ur: Kya Quran yaad karna shuru karne ki koi munasib umar hai? Woh kya hai?

dialogue.ar: في رَأْيِكَ، ما الوَقْتُ المُناسِبُ لِمُراجَعَةِ ما حَفِظْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: fī raʾyik mā l-waqtu l-munāsibu limurājaʿati mā ḥafiẓt
dialogue.en: In your opinion, what is the suitable time to review what you have memorised?
dialogue.ur: Aap ki raaye mein, jo yaad kiya uski dohrai ka munasib waqt kaunsa hai?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى التِّلاوَةِ أَكْثَرَ أَمْ تَقْرَأُ مِنَ المُصْحَفِ؟ وَلِماذا تُفَضِّلُ ذَلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal tastamiʿu ilā t-tilāwati akthara am taqraʾu mina l-muṣḥaf wa-limādhā tufaḍḍilu dhālika
dialogue.en: Do you listen to recitation more, or read from the muṣḥaf? And why do you prefer that?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap tilawat zyada sunte hain ya mushaf se parhte hain? Aur aap ise kyun pasand karte hain?

dialogue.ar: اذْكُرِ اسْماً آخَرَ لِلْقُرْآنِ الكَريمِ غَيْرَ هَذَا الاسْمِ، وَاشْرَحْ مَعْناهُ.
dialogue.tr: idhkuri sman ʾākhara lil-qurʾāni l-karīmi ghayra hadhā l-ism washraḥ maʿnāh
dialogue.en: Mention another name for the Noble Quran besides this one, and explain its meaning.
dialogue.ur: Quran-e-Kareem ka is naam ke ilawa koi doosra naam batayein aur uska matlab samjhayein.

q.ar: ما مَعْنى «تُفَضِّلُ» في سُؤالِ «أَيَّ السُّوَرِ تُفَضِّل؟»

q.ur: «ما الوَقْتُ المُناسِبُ؟» kis ke baare mein hai?
q.ar: عَنْ ماذا يَسْأَلُ سُؤالُ «ما الوَقْتُ المُناسِبُ؟»

title.en: Spelling: the soft alif in verbs

intro.en: A verb ending in a long ā sound is written with alif (ا) or yā' without dots (ى). For three-letter verbs: if the original letter is wāw, write alif (دَعا); if it is yā', write ى (سَعى). For longer verbs: write alif if a yā' comes before it (يَحْيا), otherwise write ى (اهْتَدى).
intro.ur: Jis fel ke aakhir mein lambi aa ki awaz ho woh alif (ا) ya be-nuqta ya (ى) se likha jata hai. Teen harfi fel mein agar asal harf waw ho to alif likhte hain (دَعا), agar ya ho to ى (سَعى). Teen se zyada harfon mein agar alif se pehle ya ho to alif (يَحْيا), warna ى (اهْتَدى).
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ المُنْتَهي بِأَلِفٍ لَيِّنَةٍ يُكْتَبُ بِأَلِفٍ (ا) أَوْ بِياءٍ بِلا نُقَطٍ (ى). في الفِعْلِ الثُّلاثِيِّ: إِنْ كانَ أَصْلُ الأَلِفِ واواً كُتِبَتْ أَلِفاً (دَعا)، وَإِنْ كانَ ياءً كُتِبَتْ ى (سَعى). وَفي ما زادَ عَلى ثَلاثَةِ أَحْرُفٍ: تُكْتَبُ أَلِفاً إِنْ سَبَقَتْها ياءٌ (يَحْيا)، وَإِلّا فَتُكْتَبُ ى (اهْتَدى).

q.ur: «دَعا» kaise likha jata hai aur kyun?

options: With alif, because the root letter is wāw
With ى, because the root letter is wāw
With ى, because it has four letters
With alif, because it is a noun

q.ur: «يَحْيا» alif par kyun khatam hota hai?

options: a yā' comes before the final sound

q.ar: بِمَ يَنْتَهي الفِعْلُ «اهْتَدى» وَهُوَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ ثَلاثَةِ أَحْرُف؟

q.en: Which verb is written with ى?
q.ur: Kaun sa fel ى se likha jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ الأَفْعالِ الآتِيَةِ يُكْتَبُ بِـ ى؟

title.en: Grammar: Inna and its sisters; review
title.ur: Qawaid: Inna aur uski behnein; dohrai

intro.en: Inna and its sisters (إِنَّ، أَنَّ، كَأَنَّ، لَكِنَّ، لَيْتَ، لَعَلَّ) enter a simple sentence and do the opposite of كانَ: the subject becomes accusative and the predicate stays raised. Example: الدِّينُ يُسْرٌ becomes إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ – Indeed, the religion is ease.
intro.ur: Inna aur uski behnein (إِنَّ، أَنَّ، كَأَنَّ، لَكِنَّ، لَيْتَ، لَعَلَّ) jumle par aakar Kana ke ulta kaam karti hain: mubtada mansoob ho jata hai aur khabar marfoo rehti hai. Misal: الدِّينُ يُسْرٌ se إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ – Beshak deen aasaani hai.
intro.ar: «إِنَّ» وَأَخَواتُها (إِنَّ، أَنَّ، كَأَنَّ، لَكِنَّ، لَيْتَ، لَعَلَّ) تَدْخُلُ عَلى الجُمْلَةِ الاسْمِيَّةِ فَتَعْمَلُ عَكْسَ «كانَ»: يُنْصَبُ المُبْتَدَأُ وَيَبْقى الخَبَرُ مَرْفوعاً. مِثال: الدِّينُ يُسْرٌ ← إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ.
dialogue.tr: inna d-dīna yusr
dialogue.en: Indeed, the religion is ease.
dialogue.ur: Beshak deen aasaani hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الخَطّابِ ثانِي الخُلَفاءِ الرّاشِدينَ.
dialogue.tr: inna ʿumara bna l-khaṭṭābi thānī l-khulafāʾi r-rāshidīn
dialogue.en: Indeed, Umar ibn al-Khattab is the second of the rightly guided caliphs.
dialogue.ur: Beshak Umar bin al-Khattab Khulafa-e-Rashideen mein doosre khalifa hain.

dialogue.ar: خالِدٌ فَقيرٌ، وَلَكِنَّ أَخاهُ غَنِيٌّ.
dialogue.tr: khālidun fa-qīr wa-lakinna akhāhu ghaniyy
dialogue.en: Khalid is poor, but his brother is rich.
dialogue.ur: Khalid ghareeb hai, lekin uska bhai ameer hai.

dialogue.ar: كَأَنَّ السَّفينَةَ في البَحْرِ مَدينَةٌ صَغيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: kaʾanna s-safīnata fī l-baḥri madīnatun ṣaghīra
dialogue.en: It is as if the ship at sea were a small city.
dialogue.ur: Goya samundar mein jahaz ek chhota sa shehar hai.

dialogue.ar: لَعَلَّ الأَطْفالَ راغِبونَ في تَعَلُّمِ العَرَبِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: laʿalla l-ʾaṭfāla rāghibūna fī taʿallumi l-ʿarabiyya
dialogue.en: Perhaps the children are eager to learn Arabic.
dialogue.ur: Shayad bachay Arabi seekhne ke shauqeen hain.

dialogue.ar: لَيْتَ الطَّبيبَ حاضِرٌ في المَدْرَسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: layta ṭ-ṭabība ḥāḍirun fī l-madrasa
dialogue.en: If only the doctor were present at the school.
dialogue.ur: Kaash doctor school mein maujood hota.

q.en: What happens to the subject after إِنَّ?
q.ur: Inna ke baad mubtada ka kya hota hai?
"Kaash" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
